text_en: Then Jacob called his sons, and said: “Gather around, that I may tell you what will happen to you in days to come.
text_cn: 雅各伯叫了他的儿子们来说：“你们聚在一起，我要将你们日后所遇到的事告诉你们。

text_en: Assemble and hear, O sons of Jacob; listen to Israel your father.
text_cn: 雅各伯的儿子！你们集合静听，静听你们父亲以色列的话：

text_en: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might and the first fruits of my vigor, excelling in rank and excelling in power.
text_cn: 勒乌本，你是我的长子，我的力量，我壮年的首生；你过于暴燥，过于激烈，

text_en: Unstable as water, you shall no longer excel because you went up onto your father’s bed; then you defiled it—you went up onto my couch!
text_cn: 沸腾有如滚水。你不能占据首位，因为你侵犯了你父亲的床笫，上去玷污了我的卧榻。

text_en: Simeon and Levi are brothers; weapons of violence are their swords.
text_cn: 西默盎和肋未实是一对兄弟；他们的刀剑是残暴的武器。

text_en: May I never come into their council; may I not be joined to their company— for in their anger they killed men, and at their whim they hamstrung oxen.
text_cn: 我的心灵决不加入他们的阴谋，我的心神决不参与他们的聚会；因为他们在盛怒下屠杀了人，任意割断了牛的腿筋。

text_en: Cursed be their anger, for it is fierce, and their wrath, for it is cruel! I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
text_cn: 他们的忿怒这样激烈，他们的狂暴这样凶狠，实可诅咒！我要使他们分散在雅各伯内，使他们散居在以色列中。

text_en: Judah, your brothers shall praise you; your hand shall be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons shall bow down before you.
text_cn: 犹大！你将受你兄弟的赞扬；你的手必压在你仇敌的颈上；你父亲的儿子要向你俯首致敬。

text_en: Judah is a lion’s whelp; from the prey, my son, you have gone up. He crouches down, he stretches out like a lion, like a lioness—who dares rouse him up?
text_cn: 犹大是只幼狮；我儿，你猎取食物后上来，屈身伏卧，有如雄狮，又如母狮，谁敢惊动？

text_en: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until tribute comes to him; and the obedience of the peoples is his.
text_cn: 权杖不离犹大，柄杖不离他脚间，直到那应得权杖者来到，万民都要归顺他。

text_en: Binding his foal to the vine and his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he washes his garments in wine and his robe in the blood of grapes;
text_cn: 他将自己的驴系在葡萄树上，将自己的驴驹拴在优美的葡萄树上；在酒中洗自己的衣服，在葡萄汁中洗自己的外氅。

text_en: his eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.
text_cn: 他的双眼因酒而发红，他的牙齿因乳而变白。

text_en: Zebulun shall settle at the shore of the sea; he shall be a haven for ships, and his border shall be at Sidon.
text_cn: 则步隆将居于海滨，成为船只停泊的口岸，与漆冬毗连。

text_en: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds;
text_cn: 依撒加尔是匹壮驴，卧在圈中；

text_en: he saw that a resting place was good, and that the land was pleasant; so he bowed his shoulder to the burden, and became a slave at forced labor.
text_cn: 他觉得安居美好，地方优雅；便屈肩负重，成为服役的奴隶。

text_en: Dan shall judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 丹将如以色列的一个支派，卫护自己的人民。

text_en: Dan shall be a snake by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider falls backward.
text_cn: 丹必似路边的长虫，道旁的毒蛇，咬伤马蹄，使骑士向后跌下。

text_en: I wait for your salvation, O Lord .
text_cn: 上主！我期待你的救援！

text_en: Gad shall be raided by raiders, but he shall raid at their heels.
text_cn: 加得要受袭击者袭击，但他要袭击他们的后队。

text_en: Asher’s food shall be rich, and he shall provide royal delicacies.
text_cn: 阿协尔的食物肥美，将供给君王的佳肴。

text_en: Naphtali is a doe let loose that bears lovely fawns.
text_cn: 纳斐塔里是只被释放的母鹿，发出悦耳的歌咏。

text_en: Joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a spring; his branches run over the wall.
text_cn: 若瑟是一株茂盛的果树，一株泉旁茂盛的果树；枝条蔓延墙头。

text_en: The archers fiercely attacked him; they shot at him and pressed him hard.
text_cn: 弓手令他苦恼，向他射击，与他对敌；

text_en: Yet his bow remained taut, and his arms were made agile by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, by the name of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
text_cn: 但他的弓仍旧有力，他的手臂依然灵活；这是因了雅各伯的大能者之手，因了以色列的牧者和磐石之名；

text_en: by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty who will bless you with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies beneath, blessings of the breasts and of the womb.
text_cn: 这是因为你父亲的天主扶助了你，全能者天主，以天上高处的祝福，以地下深渊蕴藏的祝福，以哺乳和生育的祝福，祝福了你。

text_en: The blessings of your father are stronger than the blessings of the eternal mountains, the bounties of the everlasting hills; may they be on the head of Joseph, on the brow of him who was set apart from his brothers.
text_cn: 你父亲的祝福，远超过古山岳的祝福，永远丘陵的愿望；愿这些祝福都降在若瑟头上，降在他兄弟中被选者的额上。

text_en: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf, in the morning devouring the prey, and at evening dividing the spoil. ”
text_cn: 本雅明是只掠夺的豺狼：早上吞食猎物，晚上分赃。”

text_en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, blessing each one of them with a suitable blessing.
text_cn: 以上是以色列十二支派，以及他们的父亲对他们所说的话。他祝福了他们，以适合每人的祝福，祝福了他们。

text_en: Then he charged them, saying to them, “I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my ancestors—in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
text_cn: 以后雅各伯又嘱咐他们，对他们说：“我快要归到我亲族那里去，你们应将我葬在赫特人厄斐龙田里的山洞里，与我的祖先在一起。

text_en: in the cave in the field at Machpelah, near Mamre, in the land of Canaan, in the field that Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
text_cn: 这山洞是在客纳罕地，面对玛默勒的玛革培拉的田内；这块田原是亚巴郎由赫特人厄斐龙买了来作为私有坟地，

text_en: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried; there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried; and there I buried Leah—
text_cn: 在那里葬了亚巴郎和他的妻子撒辣，在那里葬了依撒格和他的妻子黎贝加；我也在那里葬了肋阿。

text_en: the field and the cave that is in it were purchased from the Hittites. ”
text_cn: 这块田和其中的山洞，是由赫特人买来的。”

text_en: When Jacob ended his charge to his sons, he drew up his feet into the bed, breathed his last, and was gathered to his people.
text_cn: 雅各伯给他的儿子们立完遗嘱以后，便将脚缩到床上，断气而死，归到他亲族那里去了。
